en: Changed `--bare` sessions on an unapproved API key: moving one to the background is now refused in most setups, and `claude --bare --bg` exits with an error if the background service lacks the key
zh: 变更使用未批准 API key 的 `--bare` session：在多数配置下，将其移至后台现在会被拒绝；若后台服务缺少该 key，`claude --bare --bg` 会报错退出
